```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(showtext)
# Fuente para los graficos. Se busca en las rutas habituales del sistema en vez
# de una ruta fija; EVALUACIONES_FONT_REGULAR permite apuntar a otro archivo.
# Si no se encuentra, se usa la fuente por defecto en lugar de fallar el render.
setup_report_font <- function(family = "Libertinus Sans",
                              filename = "LibertinusSans-Regular.otf") {
  candidates <- c(
    Sys.getenv("EVALUACIONES_FONT_REGULAR"),
    file.path(sysfonts::font_paths(), filename),
    file.path(path.expand("~/Library/Fonts"), filename),
    file.path("/Library/Fonts", filename),
    file.path("/usr/share/fonts/opentype/libertinus", filename),
    file.path("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/libertinus", filename)
  )
  candidates <- candidates[nzchar(candidates) & file.exists(candidates)]

  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    message("Fuente '", family, "' no encontrada; se usa la fuente por defecto.")
    return("sans")
  }

  font_add(family = family, regular = candidates[1])
  showtext_auto()
  family
}

base_font <- setup_report_font()

# Set locale to UTF-8
Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "es_MX.UTF-8")

fix_gt_latex_accents <- function(gt_tbl) {
  x <- as.character(gt::as_latex(gt_tbl))
  
  # Corrige \\' por \'
  x <- gsub(
    "\\\\\\\\'([A-Za-zÁÉÍÓÚáéíóúÑñÜü])",
    "\\\\'\\1",
    x,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  
  # Corrige diéresis si se escaparon como \" (por seguridad)
  x <- gsub(
    "\\\\\\\\\"([A-Za-zÜü])",
    "\\\\\"\\1",
    x,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  
  # Devuelve el string limpio listo para cat()
  x
}

# Load cached metadata
md <- readRDS(params$data_file)
param_session_id <- params$session_id

# Get session info
session <- md$sessions %>%
  filter(session_id == param_session_id) %>%
  slice(1)

if (nrow(session) == 0) {
  stop(sprintf("Session ID not found: %s", param_session_id))
}

session_name <- session$group_name
# Date should already be a Date object from process_sessions_data
session_date <- session$date

# Get students in this session
session_student_ids <- session$students[[1]]

# Filter results for this session
student_scores <- md$results_general %>%
  filter(student_id %in% session_student_ids)

# Join with student names
student_scores <- student_scores %>%
  left_join(md$students %>% select(student_id, name), by = "student_id") %>%
  arrange(porcentaje) %>%  # Ascending order (worst first)
  mutate(rank = row_number())

# Calculate statistics
n_students <- nrow(student_scores)
mean_score <- mean(student_scores$porcentaje, na.rm = TRUE)
median_score <- median(student_scores$porcentaje, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_score <- sd(student_scores$porcentaje, na.rm = TRUE)
min_score <- min(student_scores$porcentaje, na.rm = TRUE)
max_score <- max(student_scores$porcentaje, na.rm = TRUE)

# Question performance - filter to questions answered by this session
session_results <- md$results %>%
  filter(student_id %in% session_student_ids)

question_performance <- session_results %>%
  group_by(Origen) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    correctas = sum(is_correcta, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(porcentaje = ifelse(n > 0, 100 * correctas / n, NA_real_))

# Join with question details from forma 10
forma_10 <- md$questions_extra

question_performance <- question_performance %>%
  left_join(forma_10 %>% select(Origen, Eje, Texto, Alternativas, Correcta), 
            by = "Origen") %>%
  arrange(porcentaje)  # Ascending order (most difficult first)

# Performance by Eje
eje_performance <- session_results %>%
  group_by(Eje) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    correctas = sum(is_correcta, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(porcentaje = ifelse(n > 0, 100 * correctas / n, NA_real_))

# Join with eje names
ejes <- md$ejes
eje_performance <- eje_performance %>%
  left_join(ejes, by = c("Eje" = "identificador")) %>%
  arrange(porcentaje)

```

# Información de la Sesión

**Grupo:** `r session_name`  
**Fecha:** `r if(!is.na(session_date)) format(session_date, "%d/%m/%Y") else "N/A"`  
**Número de estudiantes:** `r n_students`

# Estadísticas Generales

```{r stats_table, results='asis'}
stats_df <- tibble(
  Estadística = c("Media", "Mediana", "Desviación Estándar", "Mínimo", "Máximo"),
  Valor = c(
    sprintf("%.1f%%", mean_score),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", median_score),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", sd_score),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", min_score),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", max_score)
  )
)

stats_gt <- stats_df %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(60)
  )

cat(fix_gt_latex_accents(stats_gt))
```

# Resultados por Estudiante

Los estudiantes están ordenados de menor a mayor rendimiento.

```{r student_results, results='asis'}
student_results_display <- student_scores %>%
  select(Posición = rank, Nombre = name, `ID` = student_id, 
         Correctas = correctas, Total = n, `Porcentaje (%)` = porcentaje)

student_gt <- student_results_display %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Porcentaje (%)`, decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 9
  )

cat(fix_gt_latex_accents(student_gt))
```

# Desempeño por Eje Temático

```{r eje_performance_table, results='asis'}
eje_display <- eje_performance %>%
  select(Unidad = nombre, `N° Respuestas` = n, Correctas = correctas, `Porcentaje (%)` = porcentaje) %>%
  mutate(`Porcentaje (%)` = ifelse(is.na(`Porcentaje (%)`), 0, `Porcentaje (%)`))

eje_gt <- eje_display %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Porcentaje (%)`, decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 10
  )

cat(fix_gt_latex_accents(eje_gt))
```

# Desempeño por Pregunta

Las preguntas están ordenadas de menor a mayor tasa de éxito (las más difíciles primero).

```{r question_performance_table, results='asis'}
question_display <- question_performance %>%
  select(ID = Origen, Eje, `N° Respuestas` = n, Correctas = correctas, `Porcentaje (%)` = porcentaje)

question_gt <- question_display %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Porcentaje (%)`, decimals = 1) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 9
  )

cat(fix_gt_latex_accents(question_gt))
```

# Preguntas Completas (Ordenadas por Dificultad)

```{r build_questions, include=FALSE}
latex_questions <- NULL

if (nrow(question_performance) > 0) {
  # Simplified function - data is already properly formatted
  fix_macros <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return("")
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    
    # Only handle potential data quality issues
    # Collapse multiple spaces
    x <- gsub("[ ]{2,}", " ", x, perl = TRUE)
    
    return(x)
  }

  latex_questions <- paste(capture.output({
    cat("\\begin{enumerate}\n")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(question_performance))) {
      # Question ID and success rate
      q_id <- question_performance$Origen[i]
      # Escape underscores for LaTeX
      q_id <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", q_id)
      q_rate <- sprintf("%.1f", question_performance$porcentaje[i])
      q_eje <- question_performance$Eje[i]
      # Escape underscores in Eje too
      q_eje <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", q_eje)
      
      cat(sprintf("\\item \\textbf{Pregunta %s} (Eje: %s, Tasa de éxito: %s\\%%)\n\n", 
                  q_id, q_eje, q_rate))
      
      # Enunciado
      txt <- question_performance$Texto[i]
      if (is.na(txt)) txt <- ""
      txt <- fix_macros(txt)
      cat("\\begin{minipage}[t]{\\linewidth}", txt, "\n", sep = "")

      # Read alternatives from the list-column
      alts <- question_performance$Alternativas[[i]]
      if (is.null(alts)) alts <- character(0)
      alts <- fix_macros(alts)
      alts <- alts[!is.na(alts) & nzchar(alts)]

      cat("    \\begin{enumerate}[label=\\alph*)]\n")
      if (length(alts)) {
        for (a in alts) cat("    \\item ", a, "\n", sep = "")
      }
      cat("    \\end{enumerate}\n")
      
      # Correct answer
      correct <- question_performance$Correcta[i]
      if (!is.na(correct) && nzchar(correct)) {
        cat(sprintf("    \\textbf{Respuesta correcta:} %s\n", correct))
      }
      
      cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
      if (i < nrow(question_performance)) cat("\n")
    }
    cat("\n\\end{enumerate}\n")
  }), collapse = "\n")

} else {
  latex_questions <- "No hay preguntas disponibles."
}
```

```{r print_questions, results='asis'}
cat(latex_questions)
```

# Archivos Exportados

Los siguientes archivos han sido generados en el directorio de salida:

- **Lista de estudiantes:** `students_session_`r param_session_id`.txt`
- **Puntajes detallados:** Archivo Excel con puntajes individuales
- **Rendimiento por pregunta:** Archivo Excel con estadísticas por pregunta
